children: Vicapsys Life Sciences, Inc. completed a reverse merger with Stateline Distributors and signed a definitive deal to acquire the FDA‑approved NitroMist, paid via a $2.0M 15% convertible note; closing is subject to customary conditions.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Reverse merger with Stateline closed
Transforms VICP into a vertically integrated pharma distributor with existing revenue channels.
Deal to acquire NitroMist signed
Adds an FDA‑approved branded product to relaunch, creating owned margin potential.
$2.0M 15% convertible note payment
Financing terms imply dilution risk; conversion at $1.00, forced at VWAP ≥$2.50.
50‑state distribution via title model
National reach without state warehouses can accelerate product rollout.

Enables pursuit of set‑aside and sole‑source federal contracts; potential revenue access.
Talks to buy PR manufacturing site
In‑house capacity could lift margins and control supply if acquired and qualified.

This is an early-stage platform build, shifting VICP from legacy biotech to integrated pharma distribution and products. Key catalysts next: NitroMist deal closing and relaunch milestones, facility acquisition/inspection, and initial federal contract wins.

Stateline is a DSCSA-compliant specialty pharmaceutical wholesale distributor with approximately 400 active healthcare accounts in Puerto Rico and a 50-state title model executed through third-party logistics partner Drugzone
Strategic tribal 8(a) teaming agreement gives the combined company access to set-aside and sole-source federal contracting channels, including Indian Health Service pharmaceutical supply

VICP has signed a definitive agreement to acquire NitroMist® (nitroglycerin) lingual aerosol, NDA 021780, for a US$2.0million convertible note and is preparing stability, medium-fill and pre-production batches with its contract manufacturing partner for the product's relaunch

Company in discussions to acquire an approximately 120,000-square-foot former big-pharma API manufacturing facility in Puerto Rico, including 50,000 square feet of cleanroom manufacturing space and 70,000 square feet of distribution space

title: Vicapsys Life Sciences, Inc. (VICP) Closes Reverse Merger, Signs NitroMist Deal
